parts.name: Root
parts.description: State container for the dialog. Holds open state and the trigger reference, and passes state helpers ({ close, open, toggle, isOpen }) to its children snippet.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element. Can be set manually or via Dialog.Trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Children snippet receives state helpers: { close, open, toggle, isOpen }

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that registers itself as the dialog trigger and toggles the dialog on click.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

parts.name: Portal
parts.description: Portal wrapper that renders the dialog layers into the document body only while the dialog is open (staying mounted through exit animations).

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render in portal (Overlay and Content)

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: Backdrop layer rendered behind the dialog content. Its z-index is derived from the dialog's position in the stack.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the dialog is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The modal panel (role="dialog", aria-modal). Applies focus trapping, outside-interaction handling, scroll lock, and aria-hiding of outside content; close interactions only apply to the topmost dialog in a stack.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the dialog container.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether clicking outside the dialog should close it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape should close the dialog.

dataAttributes.name: data-dialog-positioner
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the fixed positioning wrapper that centers the panel.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the dialog is open, "closed" during exit.
